data.heading: Course Overview
bullets: Complete companion for the first four weeks of English for Engineering I
Compiled from all course sources including syllabus, lectures, and worksheets
Every exercise followed by full answer key with explanations
Organized as both workbook and reference grammar
Covers introductions, present simple, articles, quantifiers, and language of movement

narr: This course is designed to help foundation students move from general school English to confident, everyday and academic communication.
The scope follows the official course structure across four weeks.
Week 1 focuses on introductions and the present simple tense with adverbs of frequency.
Week 2 continues with semester planning, contrasting generalizations with stereotypes, and introduces article systems.
Week 3 is devoted to numbers and quantification including quantifiers, proportions, and numeracy vocabulary.
Week 4 turns to reading and writing about movement and change, focusing on prepositions and trends.
